source_title: WHO mental health environment and climate guidance
unit_or_scope: national cross-sector climate and mental-health policy
direct_observation: Guidance calls for mental health to be integrated into environmental conservation climate and disaster-preparedness policy with leadership financing and indicators
missing_stage: named person support receipt functioning agency and durable recovery
next_test: audit one national or local plan for funded mental-health actions and outcome measures

source_title: WHO/IASC climate mental-health and MHPSS recommendations
unit_or_scope: climate-related disasters slow-onset change and MHPSS actors
direct_observation: Recommendations address distress grief anxiety and mental-health impacts beyond disasters and call for climate considerations in mental-health and MHPSS programmes
missing_stage: culturally safe support clinical need functioning and non-pathologizing recovery
next_test: trace one climate-exposed cohort through MHPSS referral support and follow-up

source_title: WHO Western Pacific climate-shock mental-health initiative
direct_observation: WHO reports distress anxiety grief uncertainty and disrupted social support and says responses remain fragmented; initiative aims to strengthen climate-resilient inclusive systems and practical knowledge
missing_stage: named service reach quality continuity and outcome by subgroup and place
next_test: compare preparedness response and recovery pathways across two exposed communities

source_title: UNICEF Malaysia National Youth Climate Change Survey
direct_observation: 83.2 percent experienced a climate-related disaster in the prior year; 94.3 percent reported climate worry; 97.4 percent of disaster-exposed respondents reported fear grief hopelessness stress or exhaustion
missing_stage: clinical diagnosis causal attribution support receipt functioning agency and durable wellbeing
evidence_status: official UNICEF 2026 survey; self-report not clinical prevalence
next_test: link exposure subgroup support access school/work disruption and follow-up wellbeing

source_title: UNICEF Greece climate-anxiety and local pilot
unit_or_scope: young people and six municipalities in Greece
direct_observation: Youth accounts describe wildfire heat flood and water-shortage fear; 2025 pilot involved civil protection child institutions simulations and psychological first aid
missing_stage: multi-season support uptake school continuity clinical/non-clinical recovery and trust
evidence_status: official UNICEF case and pilot description
next_test: follow one municipality and cohort across hazard response referral and school continuity

source_title: WHO emergency MHPSS minimum service package
unit_or_scope: people affected by conflict climate change political instability and disasters
direct_observation: WHO says more than 300 million people need humanitarian assistance and the package defines priority MHPSS activities for emergency response
missing_stage: person-level reach safety cultural fit continuity functioning and remedy
next_test: audit package implementation for language disability gender migration and referral continuity

unit_or_scope: children and families in flood-affected Nepal including Nuwakot
direct_observation: UNICEF estimated more than 17000 children needed MHPSS and reported 18 child-friendly spaces including 13 supported by UNICEF plus psychologists counsellors and frontline workers
missing_stage: school return sustained functioning clinical recovery equitable reach and family reunification durability
next_test: follow children from safe space through referral school return household recovery and recurrence

unit_or_scope: health workers in Nuwakot and Trishuli Hospital
direct_observation: Named workers reported personal loss displacement sleeplessness and service pressure while government and partners provided MHPSS and called for sustained support
missing_stage: worker retention workload safety household recovery care continuity and later wellbeing
next_test: trace worker exposure support uptake work attendance safety and household recovery over six months

unit_or_scope: children in evacuation camps and returning communities in Timor-Leste
direct_observation: Thirteen child-friendly spaces were implemented with eight NGOs and three youth organisations reaching more than 1300 flood-affected children; follow-on community and family support continued
missing_stage: cultural fit school continuity referral completion family safety and long-term wellbeing
evidence_status: official named UNICEF island disaster case
next_test: follow a cohort from camp space through return school and community support

source_title: Lao PDR Sanamxay psychosocial and child-responsive recovery programme
unit_or_scope: children families and communities affected by 2018 floods and dam collapse
direct_observation: A 2020-24 programme combined psychosocial support social services Child Protection Networks and Savings for Change; UNICEF reports reach of over 2700 children and 160000 community members but need for sustained funding
missing_stage: trauma protection risk school continuity financial resilience and durable local service capacity
evidence_status: official named UNICEF multi-year case with sustainability boundary
next_test: compare supported and less-reached communities on protection referrals schooling coping and funding continuity
